name: Heroism
description: A willing creature you touch is imbued with bravery. Until the spell ends, the creature is immune to being frightened and gains temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier at the start of each of its turns. When the spell ends, the target loses any remaining temporary hit points from this spell.
effect: You or an ally can't be frightened, and gain temporary HP equal to your spellcasting modifier at the start of each turn, for 10 rounds (concentration).
notes: In combat: the target can't be frightened (it ends at once) and tops up to temporary HP equal to your spellcasting modifier each turn. Concentration, 10 rounds.
